test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

One who hates institution of marriage
solution: The correct answer is** option 4, Misogamist.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Misogamist **refers to **a person who hates the institution of marriage (**विवाह से घृणा करने वाला). • Example: In her own case Aunt Ida is a **misogamist **; yet she urges marriage on me. • **Option 1, Coquette,** refers to a woman who flirts with men to gain attention. (मोहिनी स्त्री किसी भी योगी का ध्यान भंग कर सकती है) • **​Option 2, Pedantic**, refers to a person who is overly concerned with minor details and rules. (नियमों और विवरणों पर अत्‍यधिक ध्यान रखने वाला; पंडिताऊ) • **Option 3, Polyglot**, refers to a person who knows and speaks multiple languages. (एक से अधिक भाषा का ज्ञान या उसमें लेखन; बहुभाषी) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The term** "misogamist" **comes from the Greek words** "misos"** meaning **"hatred" **and **"gamos" **meaning** "marriage." ** • A **misogynist**, on the other hand, is someone who dislikes, distrusts, or prejudices against women. 46:T8b6, "The correct answer is **option 4, "lives on."**
